title: FleetTelemetryEvent
description: Raw telemetry event generated by vehicle onboard sensor simulator

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the telemetry event

vehicle_id.description: Unique identifier for the vehicle (e.g. veh-001)

event_time.description: Device timestamp recorded at the vehicle sensor (subject to clock drift)

ingest_time.description: Timestamp when the event was dispatched / ingested into the pipeline

speed_kmh.description: Vehicle instantaneous speed in kilometers per hour

engine_temp.description: Engine coolant temperature in degrees Celsius
